label: prf:q-heat-equation-unique
title: Proof of uniqueness of $q$-heat equation solutions
html:
Proof. Proof of uniqueness of q-heat equation solutions

The difference v = u_1 - u_2 satisfies \partial_t v = -\Delta_q v with v(0) = 0. Project onto isotypic components: each \pi_j(v) satisfies the ODE \dot{\pi_j(v)} = -\lambda_j(q) \pi_j(v) with \pi_j(v)(0) = 0, whose unique solution is \pi_j(v) \equiv 0. Reassembling, v(t) = 0 for all t, so u_1 = u_2. Uniqueness is an eigenvalue-by-eigenvalue fact, categorical and base-ring independent.
